name: Yukun Zhang
research: Economics of artificial intelligence; AI agents and economic organization; language model learning, interpretability, and alignment.
bio: My research examines how artificial intelligence changes production, markets, and economic institutions. I study the economics of generative AI and AI agents, alongside work on how language models learn and reason, with a focus on data, architecture, interpretability, and alignment.

I am currently an LLM Data Leader at Alipay, working on pre-training data and quality governance for multilingual and multimodal models. Previously, I worked on LLM evaluation and interpretable AI at TikTok, and on pricing and data science at Alibaba and JD.com.

experience.description: Lead LLM data work, including pre-training pipelines and quality governance for multilingual and multimodal corpora.
Led data science work on LLM evaluation, interpretable AI, and algorithmic governance.
Led pricing data science and developed causal inference and experimentation tools for e-commerce.
Worked on revenue management and dynamic pricing in e-commerce.

experience.organization: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
experience.description: Researched machine learning applications in finance with Lingfei Li.
Worked on the China Gazetteer Project at the National Bureau of Economic Research.
